PUBLIC PLANNING BRIEF · D03 · VERSION 1.0 · 15 OCTOBER 2026

Dryland farm resilience

Anantapur region, Andhra Pradesh

CONCEPT · NOT READY FOR FUNDING REVIEW. This is a planning brief, not a grant-ready proposal, assessed project or request for a donation. Exact site, partners, costs and targets are pending.
THE HUMAN NEED

Farms prepared for uncertain rainfall

Farming families need production stability and viable net incomes. The proposed assessment will examine local rainfall risks, existing support and the remaining resilience gap.

This is an investigation hypothesis. Regional screening evidence does not establish the local unmet need at an unselected site.

Current stage
01 of 08 · Site selection
Accountable project coordinator
Not assigned
Funding recipient and route
Not appointed or verified
Budget and funding gap
Not costed; no commitments confirmed

The next decision

Select the current mandal and farmer cluster; obtain consent and available farm records.

Proposed outcome measurement

Weather-related production losses and net farm income. Baselines, comparison approach, targets and evaluation dates are pending.

Preparation scope to discuss

  1. Select a site and obtain access and community participation.
  2. Establish the local baseline and the remaining service gap.
  3. Compare technical options and confirm delivery and maintenance roles.
  4. Prepare a reviewed design, lifecycle costs and an outcome measurement plan.
  5. Recommend proceeding, revising or stopping, with supporting evidence.

Preparation allowance: 6–12 weeks after access and a funded assessment mandate, subject to suitable field conditions. This is a planning allowance, not a contracted deadline; no start date is scheduled.

How costs must be presented

Show assessment, technical design, implementation, monitoring, administration, maintenance and replacement separately, with dated cost evidence, assumptions and contingency. No amount or unit-cost-to-impact claim is established in this brief.

Readiness and reporting

All seven readiness fields and critical permissions require review before an implementation funding proposal. Any agreement must identify reporting responsibility, schedule, spending evidence, measurement methods and treatment of changes or unspent funds.
